features.name: Hardware Device Attestation Substrate
features.description: Hardware-backed cryptographic device attestation using Android KeyStore RSA/EC keys and challenge-response nonces.
features.known_risks: Dev environment uses software mock fallback when hardware token unavailable.

features.name: Device Binding & Instant Revocation Ledger
features.description: Cryptographic binding of STFL-DVC-* IDs to user identities with instant multi-project session cascade revocation.
features.known_risks: Network disconnect during revocation handled via short JWT expiry (15 min).

features.name: 10-Dimensional Enterprise Audit Substrate
features.description: Immutable append-only enterprise audit trail logging 10 essential dimensions with SHA-256 integrity hashing.
features.known_risks: High-throughput tables require monthly partition pruning into cold storage.

features.name: PostgreSQL Trigger-Enforced Audit Immutability
features.description: Database-level trigger aborting any UPDATE or DELETE operation on enterprise_audit_logs.
features.known_risks: Requires raw DB superuser privileges to disable (blocked via RDS/Managed PG IAM).

features.name: 13-Dimensional Contextual Authorization Engine
features.description: Multi-dimensional server-side policy evaluation across classes, roles, units, scopes, devices, and training status.
features.known_risks: Complex policy rules must be cached in memory to maintain <10ms gateway latency.

features.name: Dynamic Workspace Policy Enforcement
features.description: Database-driven console access policies eliminating hard-coded client-side authorization.
features.known_risks: Policy misconfiguration could lock out unit heads (mitigated by Super Admin oversight).

features.name: Dual-Custody Approval Engine
features.description: Constitutional anti-collusion engine enforcing creator != approver across all financial, lease, and policy mutations.
features.known_risks: Deadlocks avoided via delegation to Relief Moderator B or Unit Supervisor.

features.name: Anti-Collusion Separation of Duties Verifier
features.description: Automated verification that the disburser of funds is independent from the financial approver.
features.known_risks: Small field branches must have at least 2 distinct officers present.

features.name: Cryptographic Counter-Signature Ledger
features.description: Dual ECDSA P-256 signatures stored in approval_signatures with SHA-256 voucher payload verification.
features.known_risks: Clock drift between devices resolved via server-issued nonces.

features.name: Forensic Steganographic Document Watermarking
features.description: Yellow Micro-Dot matrix steganography encoding operator user_id, device_id, and print timestamp imperceptibly into PDF output.
features.known_risks: Requires high-resolution color laser printer for forensic physical dot recovery.

features.name: Deterministic Document ID Generator
features.description: STFL-DOC-{YEAR}-{UNIT}-{SEQ} formatting with Luhn check-digit verification.
features.known_risks: Year rollover sequences handled via PostgreSQL partitioned sequence tables.

features.name: Public Document Verification Gateway
features.description: Public route /verify/:hash allows external verification of document validity without revealing private PII.
features.known_risks: DDoS protection enforced via Cloudflare rate limiting.

features.name: Governed Multi-Channel Communications Gateway
features.description: Central dispatcher for SMS/WhatsApp/Email with anti-hallucination template approval and rate limiting.
features.known_risks: Carrier outages mitigated via multi-vendor automatic failover.

features.name: Anti-Hallucination Template Approval Substrate
features.description: Outbound messaging template validation blocking free-form AI text from reaching external parties.
features.known_risks: Template variables strictly typed using Zod regex patterns.

features.name: Autonomous Agent Runtime & Constitutional Sandbox
features.description: Agent orchestration substrate enforcing strict Level 3 authority ceiling (Read/Draft/Analyze/Recommend only).
features.known_risks: Prompt injection blocked via tool parameter JSON schema validation.

features.name: Agent Confidence Boundary Evaluator
features.description: Confidence score boundary gating rejecting recommendations below 0.98 for critical domains.
features.known_risks: 0.979999... float attacks rejected via explicit decimal comparison.

features.name: Agent Emergency Kill Switch Substrate
features.description: Global and per-agent emergency kill switch instantaneously invalidating agent execution tokens.
features.known_risks: Requires CISO Tier 1 hardware key to disengage quarantine.

features.name: 16 Core Management Consoles API
features.description: Unified Hono routes powering the 16 core enterprise management backends.
features.known_risks: Console routes strictly enforce user class boundaries.

features.name: Console 17: Compliance & Legal Console
features.description: Specialized operational console for Legal Counsel and Compliance Officers managing statutory holds.
features.known_risks: Hold releases require physical digital signature from verified counsel.

features.name: Console 18: Knowledge, Training & Service Console
features.description: Operational console for Course authoring, SOP management, quiz administration, and moderation queues.
features.known_risks: Relief moderators have full queue access but zero root administration.

features.name: Segment 01: User Learning Center
features.description: Public and field worker educational center with pictorial instructions, step-by-step videos, and audio narrations.
features.known_risks: Large media files cached locally to support offline rural operation.

features.name: Segment 02: Service & Operations Center
features.description: Active SOP runbooks, checklists, SEV-1 to SEV-4 incident procedures, and AI-assisted troubleshooting.
features.known_risks: AI troubleshooting assistant must cite ratified SOP version.

features.name: Segment 03: Administration & Governance Center
features.description: IAM manuals, cryptographic key rotation procedures, compliance guidelines, and audit manuals.
features.known_risks: Unilateral modification blocked via dual-signature requirement.

features.name: Segment 04: Moderation & Relief Center
features.description: Administrative relief tier with MODERATOR_A and MODERATOR_B providing high-availability queue relief.
features.known_risks: Zero self-approval invariant strictly enforced in code.

features.name: Controlled Moderator Work Queue
features.description: moderator_work_queue managing 9 item types (USER_HELP, ACCOUNT_SUPPORT, TRAINING_REVIEW, SOP_UPDATE, ESCALATION).
features.known_risks: SLA countdown timers trigger automated escalation to Unit Heads.

features.name: Multi-Project Tenant Isolation Engine
features.description: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security ensuring strict zero cross-project data leakage across sub-ledgers and documents.
features.known_risks: Cross-project transfers require explicit dual-leg intercompany clearing accounts.

features.name: Custom Domain & Subdomain Hostname Router
features.description: Cloudflare Workers edge router resolving project domains (e.g. greendelta-agro.org) to internal project context.
features.known_risks: SSL certificate generation automated via Cloudflare for SaaS.

features.name: Project Chart of Accounts & Sub-Ledger Engine
features.description: Independent double-entry general sub-ledger per project enforcing strict NUMERIC(18, 2) financial precision.
features.known_risks: Unbalanced transactions rejected via database constraint debit = credit.

features.name: Project Operational Lifecycle State Machine
features.description: Formal state machine governing project progression (DRAFT ➔ PILOT ➔ ACTIVE ➔ SUNSETTING ➔ ARCHIVED).
features.known_risks: Archiving a project preserves all historical audit logs immutably.

features.name: Multi-Jurisdictional Statute Resolver
features.description: Statute evaluation engine resolving applicable national, municipal, and sector laws across 21 domains.
features.known_risks: Time-travel audit evaluates rule version in effect at the exact time of transaction.

features.name: Automated Statutory Hold & Legal Review Engine
features.description: Automatic transaction freeze engine triggered on statutory breaches (e.g. advance rent > 3 mo), creating legal review tickets.
features.known_risks: Holds can only be lifted by authorized human legal counsel signature.

features.name: Pictorial / Visual-First Training Engine
features.description: Visual instructional material engine supporting 11 media types (Images, Diagrams, Flowcharts, Animations, Videos, Simulations).
features.known_risks: All visual assets verified via SHA-256 hash before delivery.

features.name: Cryptographic Training Certification Authority
features.description: Issuance of STFL-CER-* digital certificates with ECDSA P-256 signatures, passing score evaluation, and expiry tracking.
features.known_risks: Regulatory updates trigger mandatory refresher invalidation.

features.name: Training-Gated Authorization Check
features.description: 13-D Contextual Authorization engine verifies active TRAINING_STATUS before allowing sensitive operations (microfinance.collect, lease_create).
features.known_risks: Uncertified users blocked with HTTP 403 and redirected to course module.

features.name: Mandatory Platform Compliance Training Non-Erasure
features.description: Enforces that independent projects inherit and cannot silently delete or waive mandatory compliance training.
features.known_risks: Project-level deletion attempts abort with GOVERNANCE_VIOLATION_BLOCKED.

features.name: In-Workflow Contextual Walkthrough Guidance
features.description: 'Step 3 of 7' contextual visual guidance panels embedded inside production operational forms.
features.known_risks: Walkthroughs can be collapsed by experienced officers to avoid visual noise.

features.name: Dynamic Compliance Intercept in UI
features.description: Instant form field intercept converting walkthrough into a STOP / REVIEW REQUIRED barrier upon statutory threshold breach.
features.known_risks: Client validation failure prevents submission; backend 13-D auth rejects any bypass.

features.name: AI-Assisted Troubleshooting with Provenance
features.description: Operational diagnostic assistant answering queries strictly from approved, versioned SOPs with mandatory citations.
features.known_risks: Uncertain queries trigger mandatory ESCALATE_SOURCE_REVIEW.

features.name: Cloudflare Workers Edge Gateway & KV Cache
features.description: Edge network entrypoint with rate-limiting KV stores, DDoS scrubbing, TLS termination, and Hyperdrive connection pooling.
features.known_risks: Requires live Cloudflare deployment to verify production path.

features.name: Interactive Demo Mock Environment
features.description: Synthetic tenant and user sandbox generator passing 15/15 Vitest tests for safe sandbox evaluation.
features.known_risks: Demo routes strictly disabled in production builds via NODE_ENV=production check.
